name: voice-gate
description: A single-voice writing instrument in four skills. voice-gate checks a finished nonfiction piece against a supplied voice profile and renders one locked scorecard and one verdict; diagnose-only, it never edits. voice-gate-reviser applies the gate's approved findings as the smallest in-voice change. voice-gate-builder generates the profile from a corpus; voice-gate-interview builds it by consent-first interview. Both prove it through a human-graded calibration gate they never self-grade.
